material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - the two sounds of THE
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll practice the smallest word in English, and it has two different sounds. It’s... …THE! The next sound decides how we say it: the app

Before a consonant sound we say /ðə/, like in the game. Before a vowel sound we say /ði/, like in the app and the end.
